fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) recorded Q4 net revenue of $11.45 billion (12% year-over-year increase) but provided December quarter net margin guidance of 45–46%, causing intraday 4% share price decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Net margin expected to drop sharply from September quarter's 47.9% due to rising memory costs and Siri AI implementation costs, with CEO John Ternus noting memory price increases as 'unprecedented'.
fields.summary_ko.2: iPhone revenue reached $5.76 billion in September quarter, a record high, with December quarter revenue growth guidance of 7–10%.
